## Header 1

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(magrittr)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(fs)
source(here::here("R/functions.R"))
```


## Prepare HR data

```{r}
hr_data <- read_sensor_data("HR.csv.gz")
ibi_data <- read_sensor_data("IBI.csv.gz")
temp_data <- read_sensor_data("TEMP.csv.gz")
bvp_data <- read_sensor_data("BVP.csv.gz")
eda_data <- read_sensor_data("EDA.csv.gz")
```

## Process survey data

```{r}
survey_tidy <- here::here("data-raw/nurses-stress/survey-results.csv.gz") %>%
  read() %>%
  tidy_survey_dates()

survey_long <- survey_tidy %>%
  survey_to_long()
```

## Joining datasets

```{r}
nurses_stress <- survey_long %>%
  full_join(survey_tidy) %>%
  full_join(hr_data) %>%
  full_join(ibi_data) %>%
  full_join(temp_data) %>%
  full_join(bvp_data) %>%
  full_join(eda_data) %>% 
  write_csv(
    here("data/nurses-stress.csv")
    )
```
